settings.question: How do I figure out which tire type I need?
settings.answer: Three quick questions: (1) Will you drive this set through Calgary winter? Yes → winter or all-weather. No → summer or all-season. (2) Are you running ONE set year-round, or swapping seasonally? One set + winter capability → all-weather (3PMSF). Two sets → pair winter with all-season or summer. (3) What's the vehicle? Sedan/crossover/SUV → passenger or touring. Truck or heavy SUV → A/T or H/T (light truck). Trailer → ST trailer tire. Each landing page below has a fit-guide that walks through the specifics.

We DO recommend Prince Tires for the actual tire purchase because we'll match any competitor's written quote, and we carry the warranty + price-match alongside the install.

settings.question: How fast can I get a set installed in Calgary?
settings.answer: Same-day install is the default for common Calgary tire sizes — call before midday and we'll get you in. Truck and dually sizes need a 60-minute bay; trailer tires need a separate mount setup. The October–November winter rush and March–April spring changeover are the slowest weeks of the year because every Calgary tire shop is booked — book online a week ahead during those windows.

settings.heading: Tire categories — find the right type for how you drive
settings.intro: Every Calgary driver has a different mix of cold mornings, mountain trips, gravel roads, trailer hauls, and dry-summer commutes. Tire categories exist to optimize for that mix — not to confuse you. Here's how the categories actually map to Calgary driving.
settings.footnote: Not sure which category fits? Send us your vehicle year/make/model + your typical driving pattern (city / job site / trailer / off-road / track) and we'll quote the right tire. Or call (403) 452-4283 for a 5-minute walk-through.

settings.text: Sedan or crossover → passenger touring. Truck or heavy SUV → A/T or H/T light truck. Trailer → ST. Sports car or tuned EV → UHP performance.
One set all year + winter-legal → all-weather. Two sets → pair winter with all-season or summer. Year-round in a sport car → UHP all-season.
Pick for your hardest condition, not your typical day. Tow heavy once a year → load-range for that load. Drive Banff in January → 3PMSF or dedicated winter.
Premium touring all-seasons go 80,000–130,000 km. Premium winters last 4–6 seasons. UHP summer 30k–50k km. Spending more usually means more tread life, not just better grip.

settings.heading: How to choose the right tire for Calgary
settings.intro: Calgary's mix of -30°C January, +30°C August, mountain trips, gravel back roads, and pothole-heavy spring makes tire choice harder here than most cities. The good news: there's no single "best" tire — there's a right tire for how YOU drive. Four questions usually narrow it to one or two options.
settings.outro: If you're still unsure, the fastest path is a 2-minute conversation. Send your year/make/model + how you actually drive (winter mountain trips? gravel job sites? track days? boat trailer in summer?) to info@princetires.ca or call (403) 452-4283. We'll quote two or three options — not push the most expensive one.
